Why Local Processing Matters for LLM Context

When you copy a webpage into a prompt, you usually bring along the chrome: navigation, ads, and scripts. A skeletonizer strips all of that and keeps the structure.

What survives

  • Headings become #, ##, and friends.
  • Tables keep their columns.
  • Code blocks keep indentation.

Privacy by design means readable text never leaves the browser as readable text.
